items.answer: Formation of sperm. The scrotum keeps the testes about 2-3 °C below body temperature, which sperm formation requires.

items.stem: Which among the following is not the function of testes at puberty? (i) formation of germ cells (ii) secretion of testosterone (iii) development of placenta (iv) secretion of estrogen
items.answer: (iii) and (iv). The placenta develops in the female during pregnancy and estrogen is secreted by the ovary, so neither is a function of the testes.

items.stem: Assertion (A): Amoeba takes in food using finger-like extensions of the cell surface. Reason (R): In all unicellular organisms, the food is taken in by the entire cell surface.
items.assertion: Amoeba takes in food using finger-like extensions of the cell surface.
items.reason: In all unicellular organisms, the food is taken in by the entire cell surface.

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

items.answer: Amoeba takes in food using temporary finger-like extensions called pseudopodia, which extend and fuse over the food particle to form a food vacuole, so the assertion is true. A unicellular organism needs no special organ for taking in food because its entire surface contacts the environment - but that is not why Amoeba uses pseudopodia, and the reason as printed is false as a general claim.
